label: Quest

intro: Elling has sent you to find Private Hendel, and a local officer says the search sounds troubling. Hendel was stationed at the first tower outside Theramore, where you are asked to look for signs of him.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hendel? Yes, I know the man. But why would you need one of my soldiers?

Elling sent you to find him? Hmm, I don't like the sound of that. Elling wouldn't have you come to me first if your business wasn't troubling. I understand if you can't tell me what this is about, but know this: I have a duty to protect these lands. If you're going to cause a disturbance, then I suggest you inform me of whatever you can.
I believe Hendel was stationed at the first tower outside of Theramore. Be cautious.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The man you seek, the one known as Hendel, is not here. Other sources have brought to the Lady Proudmoore information I believe you already know. She has asked me to find you, and give you aid in your venture. If you would allow it, I will tell you where to find Private Hendel so we can bring him to justice.

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
